title: The librarian's pencil
logline: The pencil stub from the cardigan's pocket on the table, close, chewed at the end, and beside it the archive box's label with '(finch)' in pencil — the same pencil, the page decides by the softness of the line. The person who wrote it, as a stub.

panels.composition: Close on a chewed pencil stub on a library table beside an archive box's typed label with a word added in soft pencil in parentheses.
